status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest independent, dated evidence I could find naming this exact project ('广西LNG外输管道复线（北海LNG-贵港）') is the 2023-10-27 conference wire piece, which itself lists it only among '规划建设' (still-to-be-built) 14th-Five-Year-Plan trunk lines — no approval, EIA, or construction-start date given even there. I searched specifically for anything newer (2024–2026): NDRC/MEE approval-document indices, gas.in-en.com, Guigang/Beihai municipal DRC project-approval pages, and its sibling project's own press trail. Its sibling '广西LNG外输管道复线（百色—文山）' (part of the same 3-line ~1250km/~15bn-yuan 2023 announcement) got an EIA approval in Dec 2023, broke ground Aug 2024, and had a further EIA-change review as recently as Jan 2026 — i.e. it left clear public tracks. The Beihai LNG-Guigang line has none of that: no EIA filing, no NDRC core approval notice, and no construction/tender news later than the 2021-08 preliminary-survey tender already on the wiki page. Given the sheet's own LastUpdated (2025-08-25) does not correspond to any new evidence I could find (it looks like a housekeeping touch, not a re-verification), and the most recent substantive evidence of this specific line's status is now ~2.75 years old with a comparable sibling project having visibly progressed while this one shows nothing, applying the dormancy rule: proposed with no progress ≥2y → shelved (presumed, per standing rule 2 — no fabricated ref for the inference itself).

summary: P4716 (Beihai LNG-Guigang, proposed, 244km/1016mm): existence and status='proposed' independently confirmed as of the sheet's own cited 2023-10 article (a real, named 14th-Five-Year-Plan duplicate-line project, not a duplicate of operating P4721); flagged one misattributed ref (Fuel/PipelineType cite an unrelated 155.7km/813mm branch, values probably still fine); Length/Diameter/FuelSource/Location/Operator/Owner all UNRESOLVED (no independently verifiable source found despite extensive search); status-review verdict='stale' → proposed shelved (dormancy rule, no newer evidence than 2023-10 while a directly comparable sibling project visibly progressed through 2024-2026).
